selfExclusion.notes: Gibraltar-licensed operators serving GB customers integrate GAMSTOP by virtue of their UKGC licence, NOT their Gibraltar one. Do not conflate the two.

requirement.notes: Licensees are expected to have key equipment and real presence in Gibraltar.

verificationRequired: WHICH FRAMEWORK IS CURRENTLY IN FORCE - the 2012 RTOS or the 2025/2026 replacement. This must be resolved before any Gibraltar advice
The full technical constraint matrix under whichever framework applies
Accepted test laboratories, audit retention, RG requirements
consultantNotes: Gibraltar is mid-replacement. The only technical standard located is 13 years old while new primary and subsidiary legislation is in progress. Any advice based on the 2012 RTOS carries a high risk of being obsolete.

Many Gibraltar licensees also hold UKGC licences, in which case the binding product constraints in practice come from the UKGC RTS. Check the licence portfolio before assuming Gibraltar rules govern product design.
